'''Assimilated Horses''', known internally as '''Infhorse''', are the [[Assimilated Mobs|Assimilated Version]] of Horses. Assimilated Horses do not currently possess an [[Assimara Parasites|Assimara version]] at the time of writing, much like [[Assimilated Pig|Assimilated Pigs]]. The implications of this are unknown.

== ''Spawning'' ==
* Spawned when a Horse succumbs to [[Call Of The Hive]] below [[Evolution Phases#Phase 7|Phase 7]].
* Spawns in groups of 3 to 5, from [[Evolution Phases#Phase 2|Phase 2]] through [[Evolution Phases#Phase 7|Phase 7]], with a spawnweight of 25, once 3 Horses have been assimilated.
* Spawned by [[Stage II Beckon|Stage II]] and [[Stage III Beckon|Stage III Beckons]].
* Spawned by level 3 or higher [[Scent System|Scents]].

== ''Behavior'' ==
Assimilated Horses are Melee Combatants.

* Their Melee Attack is performed through contact damage.
* Any Mob within 3 blocks of an Assimilated Horse will be inflicted with [[Call Of The Hive|COTH]]. This does not go through walls.
* Assimilated Horses are able to traverse faster in liquids by performing small leaps.
* Assimilated Horses are able to dive in liquids to pursue submerged targets.
* Assimilated Horses have a chance to explode, dealing 15 damage in a 3.5 block radius, and releasing [[Remains|Assimilated Remains]], 3-4 [[Buglin|Buglins]], and an effect cloud of stacking Poison and [[Call Of The Hive|COTH]].
** Assimilated Horses will attempt to explode on low health, acting identically to if they would have exploded on death. 
*** When not exploding, there is a 50% chance an Assimilated Horse will drop its [[Walking Horse Head|Head]].
* If an Assimilated Horse gets 5 kills and is within range of a [[Moving Flesh]] or 3 other Assimilated Mobs<ref>Excluding [[Assimilated Ender Dragon]] and [[Assimilated Big Spider]].</ref>, it will evolve into a [[Moving Flesh]].
* If an Assimilated Horse gets 60 kills and is unable to turn into [[Moving Flesh]], it will evolve into a [[Feral Horse]].

===''Weaknesses''===
*Assimilated Horses, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.
